verse.verse_1: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
verse.verse_3: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
verse.verse_5: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
verse.verse_6: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
verse.verse_8: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
verse.verse_9: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
verse.verse_11: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
verse.verse_13: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
verse.verse_14: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
verse.verse_15: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
verse.verse_17: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
verse.verse_18: We will call the guards of hell.
verse.verse_19: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
